correctness.rationale: For arbitrary integer h>=2 the exact distance-two clique cover X=L union K_i is proved; K_i is the octahedral S2 and I_i is two triangles over the pole edge, hence contractible. The signed determinant of pole reversal is +1 on the primitive integral basis; all arm permutations preserve basis orientations. In every subgroup quotient the L image contracts to the fixed edge midpoint; each arm stabilizer acts either trivially or by a half-turn of S2 with spherical quotient and contractible I_i quotient. Thus every arm orbit supplies exactly S2. The provided dependency-free verifier independently exhausts all faces and mod-two boundary matrices for h=2..6 and reproduces the expected Lefschetz traces. Finite experiments are not offered as proof of the uniform theorem.

value.rationale: A natural geometric change in common-spine length of six-cycle books switches integral pole-reversal orientation and the full orbit topology: the one-edge books retain a sphere for the full quotient, while the close two-edge family has contractible full quotient. The theorem supplies a complete all-subgroup geometric quotient classification on an infinite family, which is more than a routine homology recomputation or a standalone numerical invariant.
